svg.title: White Curve VIII
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Shallow dividing curve preserved; not a shaped white cutout. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.nga.gov/artworks/65714; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
